routes.name: Source-faithful two-color matching and sharp finite-type extension; independent review pending

C9000074.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 074 (Kakeya in three and four dimensions.; papers: The Kakeya maximal conjecture in three dimensions; Every four-dimensional Kakeya set has full Hausdorff dimension; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

MAIN3D074.statement: 3D manuscript thm:main: the Kakeya maximal operator satisfies the L^3 estimate with arbitrary delta^{-epsilon} loss. Source: introduction.tex:17-24 and 70-closure.tex:630-645.

CRITICAL3D074.statement: 3D prop:critical-vanishing: h(p,0)=0. Source: 70-closure.tex:17 onward; depends on the local and projection-rate mechanisms.

MAXIMAL3D074.statement: 3D prop:maximal-reduction converts the critical p>2 estimate to the L^3 maximal bound. Source: 70-closure.tex:383 onward.

LOCAL3D074.statement: 3D prop:local-bound, local dense-shading estimate. Source: 20-local.tex:66 onward; the external inputs and weighted reduction are not verified here.

WEIGHTED3D074.statement: 3D lem:weighted-convex-set extends the dense-shading set input to weighted/repeated tubes. Source: 05-inputs.tex:74-175.

SETINPUT3D074.statement: 3D thm:set-input, dense-shading union bound with convex clustering, cites Guth-Wang-Zahl arXiv:2601.14411v1, Theorem 1.1. Source: 05-inputs.tex:53-71. External theorem not independently rechecked in this mission.

MULTILINEAR3D074.statement: 3D thm:multilinear-input, endpoint multilinear Kakeya estimate. Source: 05-inputs.tex:416-438.

FURSTENBERG3D074.statement: 3D thm:furstenberg-input, planar Furstenberg estimate for projected shadings. Source: 05-inputs.tex:300-351.

MAIN4D074.statement: 4D thm:main: every Kakeya set in R^4 has Hausdorff dimension 4. Source: 01-introduction.tex:8-17,276-317. No certification of this theorem is asserted.

MODEL4D074.statement: 4D thm:model-reduction and lem:normalization reduce and normalize a Kakeya counterexample to weighted exact chart problems. Source: 02-framework.tex:666,1161 onward.

CRITICALPATH4D074.statement: 4D prop:critical-path, prop:tangent-palette, and prop:candidate-upgrade supply critical paths and recoverable chart assignments. Source: 04-critical-paths.tex:121-240,485,1105 onward; terminal extension relies on comparison.

COMPARISON4D074.statement: 4D local graph matching and terminal time extension compare algebraic sheets. Source: 03-comparison.tex:781 onward; these implications and algebraic continuation are outside the scoped matching certification.

ALGEBRAIC4D074.statement: 4D lem:algebraic-norm and fixed-format algebraic continuation compare sheet norms and finite jets. Source: 03-comparison.tex:26-268. Not audited by this mission.

ISOTROPIC4D074.statement: 4D thm:isotropic-improvement handles zero narrowness, with prop:degree-restoration for higher-jet corrections. Source: 06-isotropic.tex:15,1570 onward.

FINITE4D074.statement: 4D thm:scalar-mesh-projection is the scalar projection input for finite narrowness. Source: 07-finite-narrowness.tex:45 onward.

RATES4D074.statement: 4D prop:critical-rate, prop:bootstrap, and prop:offcritical-wide handle critical and offcritical rates. Source: 08-critical-rates.tex:77,443,811 onward.

UNBOUNDED4D074.statement: 4D prop:unbounded-improvement handles infinite narrowness by full-time localization. Source: 09-unbounded-narrowness.tex:10 onward.

MATCH074.statement: Engineer supplies a full proof of lem:two-color-matching, including arbitrary smooth lists, arbitrary priors, correlated event laws, fixed orders, and fixed-power robustness. Source: 03-comparison.tex:278-778. Independent review remains open.

JET074.statement: Nested jet records have support exponent at most d+r(1), with pre-selection descendant counts. Source: a02:jet-scales through a02:descendant-count.

PALETTE074.statement: Entropy pigeonholing gives good steps with likelihood exponent b^{5/4} and positive successful-path mass.

KERNEL074.statement: One start-dependent control measure dominates all full-past killed adaptive kernels; backward iteration controls necessary tests without survival renormalization.

ENDPOINT074.statement: For arbitrary order m, the signed-time endpoint determinant is Vandermonde times consecutive control gaps; the actual adaptive sampling law is bounded by the descendant target volume.

DET074.statement: Arbitrary-order factorial-scaled, column-weighted, row-reversed Vandermonde determinant identity for the endpoint Jacobian.

LIMIT074.statement: The fixed-grid limits, then b->0, then removal of trims force d>=1; diagonalization gives a uniform small fixed-power tolerance.

CORE074.statement: The ledger earned closed_kernel for the universal endpoint determinant and arbitrary-length finite hidden-history product domination. The compiler does not certify the full continuous lemma; independent fidelity review remains open.

FIBERBOUND074.statement: Basu arXiv:1409.1534v1 Theorem 2.17 bounds polynomial sign-condition components uniformly in coefficients; the inverse function theorem turns this into a regular-fiber multiplicity bound. Source read by Engineer; independent citation attribution pending.

PROFILE074.statement: Retaining the full target-volume exponent gives d >= integral_0^1 (m(a)+1)/2 da for a homogeneous gap profile, with no d<1 assumption used before the concluding inequality.

SHARP074.statement: For pure order-m matching, arbitrary smooth lists and arbitrary-prior dominated couplings require d >= (m+1)/2, with uniform fixed-power exclusion below the threshold; a polynomial lattice family attains it for every integer L>=2. Independent correctness, significance, and novelty review pending.

LATTICE074.statement: For every m>=1 and L>=2, the explicit two polynomial coefficient lattices at N=L^m have sizes N^((m+1)/2) and C_m N^((m+1)/2), difference (t-floor(Lt)/L)^m on sampled events, and both required index-time marginal bounds with constant losses.

REVIEW074.statement: Host-invoked independent Reviewer must replay the certificate, read the full continuous argument and statement fidelity, independently attribute cited propositions, and assess publishable significance and novelty. No independent review has occurred.
